messages.author: d6d83e22ef3ba9f1
messages.subject: Start Values Error
parts:
Hello, 

With the new 0.6-8 update to lavaan I'm getting a new error message when trying to set start values using the start argument within the sem function. I've attached code and the data I've been using showing how it worked with version 0.6-7 and produces an error in 0.6-8 that I've been unable to troubleshoot in different ways. Any suggestions you can provide for setting start values in a similar fashion with the new update would be hugely appreciated. 

Thanks very much!
 -Andrew

messages.author: d6d83e22ef3ba9f1
messages.subject: Re: Start Values Error
parts:
Apologies it seems that I'm not able to include attachments for some reason so I'm posting the code below and happy to send along the relevant .RData object if that's helpful. 

Thanks again!
 -Andrew 

#load in necessary pieces to run model
load("StartsError.RData")

#works with prior version of lavaan
library(devtools)
install_version("lavaan", version = "0.6.7", repos = "http://cran.us.r-project.org")
require(lavaan)
Results <- sem(model = Model, sample.cov = cov, estimator = "DWLS", WLS.V = V, sample.nobs=2, start=Model$ustart)


#fails with new 0.6-8 update
install.packages('lavaan')
require(lavaan)
#prints error of containing 46 elements but expects 15 free
Results_New <- sem(model = Model, sample.cov = cov, estimator = "DWLS", WLS.V = V, sample.nobs=2, start=Model$ustart)

#try troubleshooting by listing all non-free parameters as NA
Model$ustart<-ifelse(Model$free == 0, NA, .05)
#same error
Results_New <- sem(model = Model, sample.cov = cov, estimator = "DWLS", WLS.V = V, sample.nobs=2, start=Model$ustart)

#try setting to 0 instead for non-free parameters
Model$ustart<-ifelse(Model$free == 0, 0, .05)
#same error
Results_New <- sem(model = Model, sample.cov = cov, estimator = "DWLS", WLS.V = V, sample.nobs=2, start=Model$ustart)

#try just setting .05 15 times for 15 free parameters
#new error of missing values where TRUE/FALSE needed
Results_New <- sem(model = Model, sample.cov = cov, estimator = "DWLS", WLS.V = V, sample.nobs=2, start=rep(.05,15))

messages.subject: Re: Start Values Error
parts:
Andrew,

It would help to see your errors and warnings, as well as your model syntax.

However, I wonder if what you're seeing is a downstream effect of some change in handling an insufficient sample size. sample.nobs=2 seems a very strange thing to do.

Pat

messages.subject: Re: Start Values Error
parts:
Hi Pat, 

Thanks very much for your help with this! Since I posted that message it's no longer throwing the error when directly feeding it 15 start values using something like rep(.05,15) so it no longer seems to be an issue. It was previously written to feed it the start values using the output from a previous model which wasn't causing an error in version 0.6-7, but the alternative of just giving lavaan a vector of starts works just as well. 

Thanks again!
 -Andrew
